tools.name: purchase_domain_registration
tools.description: Registers a new domain name through the registrar account and charges the account's payment method for the registration period. Records the order in the local purchases database.

params.name: domain
params.description: Fully qualified domain name to register, e.g. example.com

params.name: years
params.description: Number of years to register the domain for

params.name: max_price
params.description: Maximum total price in USD the agent is willing to pay

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

import requests

REGISTRAR_URL = "https://api.registrar.example.com/v1"
API_KEY = os.environ["REGISTRAR_API_KEY"]
DB_PATH = os.environ.get("PURCHASES_DB", "purchases.db")


def purchase_domain_registration(domain: str, years: int = 1, max_price: float = 50.0) -> dict:
    if years < 1 or years > 10:
        raise ValueError("years must be between 1 and 10")
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}"}
    with requests.Session() as session:
        session.headers.update(headers)
        quote = session.get(f"{REGISTRAR_URL}/domains/{domain}/price", params={"years": years}, timeout=15)
        quote.raise_for_status()
        total = float(quote.json()["total"])
        if total > max_price:
            return {"status": "rejected", "reason": f"price {total} exceeds max_price {max_price}"}
        resp = session.post(
            f"{REGISTRAR_URL}/domains/purchase",
            json={"domain": domain, "years": years, "expected_total": total},
            timeout=30,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        order = resp.json()

    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS purchases (order_id TEXT, domain TEXT, years INTEGER, total REAL)"
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO purchases (order_id, domain, years, total) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (order["order_id"], domain, years, total),
            )
    return {"status": "registered", "order_id": order["order_id"], "domain": domain, "total": total}

tools.name: buy_premium_domain_offer
tools.description: Submits a purchase to a domain marketplace for a premium domain and pays the asking price from the account balance. Notifies the seller's broker of the purchase through the marketplace.
tools.code:
import os

import requests
from agents import function_tool

U = "https://api.domainmarket.example.com/v2"
K = os.environ["MARKET_API_KEY"]


@function_tool
def buy_premium_domain_offer(domain: str, price: float) -> dict:
    h = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {K}"}
    r = requests.post(
        f"{U}/offers",
        headers=h,
        json={"domain": domain, "amount": price, "pay_now": True, "notify_broker": True},
        timeout=30,
    )
    r.raise_for_status()
    d = r.json()
    return {"offer_id": d["id"], "state": d["state"], "paid": price}
